caption: The drawing depicts an outdoor scene set in nature, featuring two human figures prominently in the foreground. The left figure is a woman sitting on the ground, wearing a red and pink dress with some white areas, holding a long stick or rod in her left hand and a white object in her right hand. To her right stands a man dressed in a blue coat with white detailing, blue breeches, white stockings, and black shoes; he holds a black hat in his left hand. Both figures are situated near a tree with greenish-blue leaves and a brown trunk at the right edge. In front of the seated woman, there is a basket with what appears to be small birds or chicks inside. A small brown and white animal is seen on the ground to the left of the woman, and in the lower section of the image several animals are depicted, including a stag with antlers and multiple running hounds or dogs, all shown in shades of gray, tan, and light blue. The landscape background includes a variety of green-blue leafy trees, a large house or building with a red roof on the left, a body of water in blue tones, and tufts of grass throughout. Flying creatures like a butterfly above the seated woman and a blackbird near the foliage are present. Scattered in the lower part of the drawing are red circular shapes, possibly flowers. The colors are primarily soft hues of green, blue, beige, tan, red, and brown, with black and white used for detail. The composition is dense with objects distributed throughout, with foreground elements rendered larger.
title: Petit Point Embroidery
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
